questions.description: 统计单词频次并输出前 2。

questions.code_template:
data = {"user": {"name": "Tom", "age": 25}}
name = data["user"]["name"]
age = data["user"]["age"]

questions.solution:
data = {"user": {"name": "Tom", "age": 25}}
name = data["user"]["name"]
age = data["user"]["age"]
print(name, age)
